Dark InfusionRank 1
30% of base mana
Instant cast
3 Charges, 30 sec recharge
Infuse an ally with dark energy, healing them for 66 the next time they take damage. When the heal occurs, Dark Infusion is consumed and expands to the two lowest-health nearby party or raid members. Each secondary infusion heals when triggered, then expands to three nearby allies.
